title: Trace-dual bases over characteristic-zero fields
statement: Let $K\subseteq L$ be fields [def-weil-field], with $K$ of characteristic zero and $L$ finite-dimensional over $K$ [def-weil-finite-dimensional-subspace]. Write $\operatorname{Tr}_{L/K}:L\to K$ for the $K$-linear map whose value at $z$ is the trace [def-weil-endomorphism-trace] of $x\mapsto zx$ on $L$. For every $K$-basis $(v_i)_{1\leq i\leq d}$ of $L$, there is a $K$-basis $(w_j)_{1\leq j\leq d}$ of $L$ satisfying $$\operatorname{Tr}_{L/K}(v_iw_j)=\begin{cases}1&i=j,\\0&i\ne j.\end{cases}$$
